explanations.2: This line registers several file types as CGI scripts, which tells Apache to treat .php, .pl, .py and other files as programs to execute rather than serve as plain text.
explanations.6: The regex pattern here matches filenames ending in .asp, .aspx, .cgi, .php, .pl, or .py; the question mark after 'p' makes the 'x' optional so it catches both .asp and .aspx files.
